name: unifi
description: Your UniFi network in Claude: read clients, devices, networks, WiFi, firewall and VPN through the official UniFi Network API. Optional, off by default: a few changes, each applied only after your explicit approval.

api_key.title: UniFi API key
api_key.description: Cloud mode: a Site Manager key from https://unifi.ui.com/settings/api-keys. Local mode: an Integrations key created in your console's Network app

console_host.title: Console address (local mode)
console_host.description: Leave empty to use the cloud. Set to your console's IP or hostname (for example 192.168.0.1) to connect directly with an Integrations key. TLS verification is skipped in this mode

enable_writes.title: Allow changes (off by default)
enable_writes.description: Lets Claude plan changes (restart a device, enable/disable a firewall policy, edit a traffic list). Each change is applied only after you approve it in the chat and in the permission prompt, and is logged
